newsitem.title: UK: SOCCER-EVERTON DRAW CUP KNOCKOUT KINGS YORK.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-EVERTON DRAW CUP KNOCKOUT KINGS YORK.

text.p: Second division York, conquerors of Manchester United in the English League Cup last season, were given the chance to claim the prized scalp of Everton in Thursday's second round draw.
Tottenham and Chelsea were also handed difficult games against former league giants Preston and Blackpool respectively.
Five other premier league clubs faced testing two-leg ties against lower division sides.
Blackburn play second division Brentford, Leicester face third division Scarborough, West Ham meet Barnet, also third division, Sunderland play Watford and Derby tackle Luton, both second division.
Last season's beaten finalists Leeds open their campaign against third division Darlington and league leaders Sheffield Wednesday start against first division Oxford.
Holders Aston Villa and the four other clubs involved in European competitions - Manchester United, Liverpool, Newcastle and Arsenal -- are exempt from the second round.
The matches are scheduled for the weeks beginning September 16 and 23.
